test_specification: Create an end-to-end test that validates the complete autonomous error handler workflow. The test should: (1) Create a temporary log file, (2) Start the LogTrigger daemon watching that file, (3) Append an error to the log file, (4) Verify the daemon triggers the log_error_handler flow, (5) Verify the flow goes through all expected steps: investigate -> implement -> test, (6) Verify the flow completes successfully, (7) Clean up the daemon. This is a real integration test that exercises the entire autonomous cycle.

def test_something(tmp_path: Path) -> None:

context.example_test_file:
from tasktree.core.executor import run_flow


def test_log_error_handler_with_retry_success() -> None:
    """Test that retry flow works when test passes on first attempt."""
    flow_input = {
        "error_log": "TypeError: test error",
        "retry_count": 0,
        "max_retries": 2,
        "previous_attempts": [],
    }

    session = run_flow("log_error_handler", flow_input)

    # Should go: investigate -> implement -> test -> end (tests pass)
    assert session.flow_name == "log_error_handler"

    # Verify steps were executed in order
    step_names = [s.step_name for s in session.steps]
    assert step_names == ["investigate", "implement", "test"]

    # Should end with tests_passed
    assert session.steps[-1].result.label == "tests_passed"
